summary: Hallmark Venture Group filed an 8-K reporting the assignment of an impaired promissory note (original principal $100,000, 8% interest, matured October 2024) to related party SB Technology Holdings for $1,000 cash. The board determined this consideration represented fair value given the note's collectibility risk. The assignment was non-recourse, on an as-is basis. The transaction is a related-party assignment of a defaulted note, not a material divestiture of a business or asset class, and does not rise to the level of a special-situation category.
